criteria.false: There is no currently applicable explicit denial or positive withdrawal. A later affirmation by the SAME attributed speaker replaces that speaker's earlier denial. Explicit withdrawal of a negative commitment leaves unknown unless a positive statement exists; withdrawal never affirms by itself. Another speaker's reply does not withdraw this speaker's commitment. Silence, similar topic and absence of positive support are not refutation. Match the speaker and the ORDERED source and target propositions before applying a denial or withdrawal. Withdrawing P implies Q says nothing about Q implies P, which remains unsupported and unrefuted unless separately stated. A withdrawn denial stays withdrawn when later turns discuss other matters; unrelated speech does not reinstate it. Negation inside P or Q is part of that proposition, not a denial of the whole directed relation. Reporting another person's stance without endorsement is not the reporter's denial.
